Only the FMOD Engine runtime library that Kitten Space Agency loads on macOS is
redistributed here: libfmod.dylib, the core library, as shipped in
api/core/lib/ of the FMOD Engine 2.03.15 for Mac package (universal binary,
x86_64 and arm64), unmodified. FMOD Studio, the FMOD Studio API library, the
logging libraries, SDK headers, documentation, examples and example media are
not included. Kitten Space Agency uses FMOD under its developer's own license;
its Linux release ships FMOD 2.03 for Linux.

scripts/make-app.sh copies libfmod.dylib into the app unchanged, with its
original signature.
